agenda_text:
BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JULY 24, 2025
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

Matthew Peterson, Chair  Jeffrey Cozart, Commissioner
Jann Kronick-Gath, Vice Chair  David Link, Commissioner
Deborah Castro, Commissioner  Jodi Meade, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO PW-BSPBIAAC@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55880  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Belmont Shore Parking and
  Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission meeting of Thursday, June 26,
  2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-55881  Recommendation to receive and file a Long Beach Public Works financial report
  discussing revenues during the period ending June 30, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-55882  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Transit Employee Bus Pass
  Program Status for June 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-55883  Recommendation to receive status updates on Conservation Corps of Long
  Beach’s work in the Belmont Shore area, including responses to requests for
  assistance, for June 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-55884  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion regarding the security operations
  along Belmont Shore.

  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JULY 24, 2025
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-55885  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion regarding the city owned parking
  lots and after-hours parking along the Belmont Shore.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory
Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments
unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Kimberly Luna, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 24 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Kimberly Luna at Cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
